internal_measurement.results: Release-mode USI binary was rebuilt from commit 571e27f. Workspace tests, release core tests, lint, formatting, the stdlib A/B-runner early-stop test, documentation-reference, public-surface, release-manifest, and cargo-publish-workflow checks passed. external_opponents.configuration: No external-engine comparison was run for v0.3.53.

known_limitations: The mate-in-one scan only considers direct contact and knight checks; None does not prove that no mate in one exists.
S29 applies only to its pre-registered local configuration and is not a general playing-strength or external-engine superiority claim.
No NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted; the optional v0.3.38 checkpoint and its material-baseline recommendation remain unchanged.
External HalfKP 256x2-32-32 inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
